title: fix(metadata-protocol): a .custom pair's published override of a page, app, dataset, doc or book is served from its row by every read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8XgtQ7Gh7PURXHo26gxhWum)_

Fixes #29613
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`.custom` 配对包对基础包页面、应用、数据集、文档、文档书的已发布覆盖，所有读取都从覆盖自己的存储行提供，和仪表盘、报表一样；注册表裸槽位不再放一份穿着基础包信封的副本。`/me/apps` 改读协议的有效列表。
- 为什么改：这五种类型不接受环境覆盖，读取把配对包的覆盖行也当成被封存的覆盖拒掉，覆盖只能靠裸槽位副本提供。真实启动（有元数据服务）时按名读取返回基础包原件，列表却返回覆盖，分层读取和配对包的按包层从来看不到覆盖，违背 ADR-0146 D8。
- 风险与回滚：按名读取（真实启动）、分层读取的 effective、按包层会变化，全部朝 D8 方向，席位已批准；已经返回覆盖的读取不变。回滚即还原本 PR，无需迁移，重启即按新规则重新水合。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts` 的 `declinesStoredRow`；`protocol-package-bindings.ts` 的两个类型清单；`plugin-hono-server` 的 `servedAppsOf`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`，预期 24 个用例全绿（其中五种类型各两种启动形态、重启前后）。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地

## What changes

A `.custom` pair's published override of a base's `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc` or `book` is now served from its stored row by every read, the way a dashboard's or report's already is. The registry's bare slot no longer holds a copy of it wearing the base's envelope.

These five types are sealed (ADR-0131 D6: `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`). Every read asked `declinesStoredRow`, which declined their stored rows as overlays of managed content (`isUnservedSealedOverlay`), and that included the pair's declared override. The only place the override was served from was the bare slot. With a metadata service (every real boot), the by-name read answered the service's copy of the base's body before it reached the registry.

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts`: `declinesStoredRow` admits, for these five types, the shipping package's declared override, judged by `isServedOverrideRowOf` on the row's own `package_id` and body against `packagedArtifactOwner`. This is the same admission flow got in #28412, and the same predicate the boot's sealed-overlay census already uses to leave the override out of its warning. Every other sealed row of the name stays declined. Every reader already passes the row it serves (by-name, both lists, layered, the per-package customizations read), so no reader is edited.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts`: the closed list `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` and `servesSealedOverrideRow`; the five types join `BORROWED_ENVELOPE_DECLINED_TYPES`, so the #22057 guard keeps their row out of the bare slot under #29600's condition (the row's package ships no artifact of the name while another package does). The #4624 two-shipper case keeps its bare entry. `mapping` (overridable and sealed) is left out: no card measured its reads. `action` and `flow` wait for ADR-0146 D9.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: comments only. Three docblock sentences that said these five types still register in the bare slot are corrected. No code line changes.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts`: `GET /me/apps` lists the protocol's served apps (`getMetaItems({ type: 'app' })`, what `GET /meta/app` serves) when a protocol service with that read is present. With no protocol service, today's registry path is unchanged. A protocol list read that throws is warned once and answered from the registry. File surface confirmed with the seat first.
- `.changeset/29613-sealed-pair-override-row-served.md`: patch for both packages.

## Why

ADR-0146 D8 item 2: every read that serves a base's name serves the `.custom` item that declares it. Item 3: the pair's per-package layer carries the overriding item, and the base's carries the base unchanged. Measured on main `744211fc` (table below), these five types broke both items, and on a real boot the by-name read and the list disagreed about the same name.

The card's two hypotheses reconcile: the #29600 harness has no metadata service, so its by-name read fell to the bare slot (override); the #29649 real-boot reading has one, so its by-name read answered the shipped body. Both readings are reproduced below, one harness run each way.

## Tests

**Before and after, per type.** Identical for `page`, `app`, `dataset`, `doc` and `book`. S = the shipped body, O = the pair's published override. Before = main `744211fc`, the #29600 harness, without and with a metadata service holding the code package's bodies. After = this branch, both shapes, and after a restart.

| Reader | Before, no metadata service | Before, with one (a real boot) | After (both, and after a restart) | ADR-0146 D8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `getMetaItem` (no package, BASE, PAIR) | O | **S** | O | item 2 |
| `getMetaItems` (no package, BASE) | [O] | [O] | [O] | item 2 (unchanged) |
| `getMetaItemLayered(BASE).effective` | **S** | **S** | O | item 2 |
| per-package layer, PAIR | **[]** | **[]** | [O] | item 3 |
| per-package layer, BASE | **[S, O]** | **[O]** | [S] | item 3 |
| registry bare slot | O wearing BASE | O wearing BASE | none | |
| `registry.getItem` (bare, BASE, PAIR) | O | O | S | registry-direct |
| `registry.getAllApps` (app) | [S, O] | [S, O] | [S] | registry-direct |
| `GET /me/apps` (app) | the registry's list | the registry's list | the protocol's served list: O | item 2 |

Each moved reading is seat-approved as code aligning to D8 (no protocol change, so `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`).

New and extended pins:

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: a second top-level describe in #29600's shared harness file (the rule on main since #29633). Per type, with and without a metadata service, every reader in the table at once and after a restart over the same stores (10 tests). CONTROL per type: a package-less environment row of the base's name (pre-seal hatch residue) stays unserved: by-name and layered answer S (5 tests). The driver now takes optional shared stores and a module-level id counter so a restart works; the #29600 tests are untouched otherwise. 24/24 green.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.sealed-override.test.ts` (new; the module had no test file): the two closed lists agree, plural spellings fold, `mapping`/`action`/`flow`/regime-O types are outside, the #4624 case keeps its bare entry. 20/20 green.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-delegated-resolution.test.ts`: a `[#29613]` describe beside the file's other `/me/apps` pins. With a protocol service the served list is the source and the registry is not read; with none, or with a protocol that has no list read, the registry as before; a failing list read is warned and answered from the registry. 14/14 green.

<details><summary>Ablation (both mechanism lines back to main's behaviour)</summary>

The fix was committed first. `servesSealedOverrideRow` was mutated to return false (marker `ABLATION29613`) and the five types were removed from `BORROWED_ENVELOPE_DECLINED_TYPES` (marker `ABLATION29613B`), `grep -c` = 2 on disk, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`.

```
objectql protocol-custom-override-sealed-row-served (now folded into the shared file):
  × page/app/dataset/doc/book, with no metadata service: every reader serves the override, at once and after a restart
  × page/app/dataset/doc/book, with a metadata service (a real boot): every reader serves the override, at once and after a restart
  Tests  10 failed | 5 passed (15)      <- the 5 CONTROL cases stay green, by design
metadata-protocol protocol-package-bindings.sealed-override:
  Tests  6 failed | 14 passed (20)
restore: git checkout HEAD -- protocol-package-bindings.ts; DIFF-HEAD-EMPTY=yes; rebuilt;
  ablation-dist-preflight --absent: tree clean against HEAD, ABSENT-EXIT=0
```

The preflight's presence leg printed a refusal about an untracked path at that moment instead of a marker count. The 10 objectql reds read the protocol from `dist/`, which is the evidence the mutation reached it.

`/me/apps` ablation (`ablation-replace.mjs`, `servedAppsOf(ctx)` replaced by `undefined`, source-imported): 2 failed | 2 passed (the two served-list cases red; the two registry cases green by design); restored, blob equals HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Two shippers of one of these names: the admission judges the row against `packagedArtifactOwner` (the first package the artifact lookup answers), as flow's admission does. A pair override of the OTHER shipper would stay declined, and with the guard its bare entry goes too. Not measured; no shipped stack has two packages shipping one page, app, dataset, doc or book name.
- `mapping` is overridable and sealed and has the same shape. Left out on purpose (no measurement).
- Serial with #29649: it has not landed on `main` at this branch's merge, so its 8-type real-boot export pin is not on this tree yet. The seat re-runs it after whichever lands second.
- The base export (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) is not touched. With this PR the base's per-package layer lists S alone for these types, which is what #29649's filter assumes.
